scientific_integrity: Integral homotopy theorem obtained from explicit uniform graph folds and deletion-link cofibration, using published path/cycle facts and a cited vertex-deletion lemma. Finite computations corroborate but do not prove universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies one-rung deletion only for n congruent to 1 or 2 modulo 4; other residues, cycle-edge deletion, and equivariant homotopy are not claimed. An unindexed equivalent result is possible.
title: Two-sphere homotopy after deleting a rung of a Möbius ladder
